top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at La Ciclobrava by Lapierre. Practice on four-pass paved sportive on narrow public roads: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 93 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic La Ciclobrava by Lapierre's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
62ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At La Ciclobrava by Lapierre, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of La Ciclobrava by Lapierre. Train it until it feels boring.
5,761ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at La Ciclobrava by Lapierre. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
5,761ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on four-pass paved sportive on narrow public roads can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,761ft of climbing on four-pass paved sportive on narrow public roads does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for La Ciclobrava by Lapierre’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at La Ciclobrava by Lapierre rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on four-pass paved sportive on narrow public roads between girona and the costa brava to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 93 miles of four-pass paved sportive on narrow public roads between girona and the costa brava in Girona, Costa Brava, Spain.
